provenance.v6_observed_scope: Only envelope-context-decryptor, attenuated-capability-verifier, and transactional-release-pointer calibration outcomes were observed; no V6 evaluation cells ran.
provenance.v7_terminal_status: INVALID before heldout evaluation and calibration gate
provenance.v7_failure: At turn 6 the baseline CSV invocation had changed the CSV implementation but did not write .agentharness/repair-response.json, so receipt accounting failed before any heldout result or gate decision.
provenance.v7_csv_exclusion: The observed CSV diff is outcome-aware evidence and streaming-csv-quoted-records is excluded from V8.
provenance.turn_budget_rationale: Eight turns are six work turns plus two operational turns for receipt creation and verification; A and B receive the same eight-turn budget.
provenance.unobserved_scope: No real outcome was observed for context-complete-authorization-cache, length-prefixed-frame-parser, or atomic-batch-state-machine.
provenance.non_adaptation_commitment: The paired endpoint and 5-of-6 threshold are unchanged; authorization cache replaces the outcome-aware CSV task.
provenance.claim_boundary: V8 is exploratory, conditionally gated, outcome-aware in motivation, and cannot support an independent confirmatory or generally causal claim.

calibration_rule.admit: All three invocations and heldout reference/guard checks are valid, all guards pass, and at least two of three anchors do not recover the target.
calibration_rule.ceiling_abort: With otherwise valid accounting and guards, two or three anchors recover the target; execute zero evaluation cells.
calibration_rule.invalid: Any invocation, receipt, heldout result, target accounting, guard accounting, or guard result is invalid.

quota_rule.admit_if: projected_usage <= 76 and every pre-cell reduced usage < 76
quota_rule.on_failure: Stop before the next provider call and classify as provider/quota limitation.

cell_contract.materialization: Source-native V8 profile: V5 reference path with V6 AST selector compilation and V8 complete-roster leakage scan.
cell_contract.start: A and B are byte-identical clones of one source-native controlled defect.
cell_contract.A-baseline: Public SPEC and claims template only.
cell_contract.B-agentharness: Same public inputs plus one immutable opaque V8 review finding sourced from V5 finding content.
cell_contract.heldout_timing: Evaluate both cells only after both repairs in the block have completed.

primary_endpoint: Per-task paired binary success: target check passes and every sibling/common guard passes.

decision_rule.GO: B>A on at least 5 of 6 tasks, A>B on zero tasks, B target recovery on at least 5 of 6 tasks, and zero B guard regressions.
decision_rule.NO-GO: A valid complete study that does not satisfy every GO condition.
decision_rule.INVALID: Incomplete roster, invalid accounting/evaluation, treatment contamination, or integrity failure.

secondary_report: Descriptive only; it cannot override the unchanged primary decision.
